name: provider-router
summary: Opt-in model router that switches between two operator-configured models (hot_path_model and strong_model) by task class from PI_KIT_ROUTING_POLICY; a no-op when the policy is unset. The policy may also list up to three fallback models: on a credit, rate-limit or server failure reported by finish-reason-retry the session moves to the next one that is not cooling down and returns afterwards. It does not select providers by cost or manage local model runtimes.
